definition: to do much better than everyone else
description: Under a concrete motorway bridge at night, with graffiti on the pillars and coloured string lights. A young woman in a red jacket and black trousers balances in a one-hand freeze on a square wooden dance mat, her legs high in the air, then springs up to her feet. Behind her a big crowd of young people in bright tracksuits cheer with raised arms, a young man in blue bows down to the ground in front of her, and she points at the camera with a big smile. A speaker stands beside the mat.

taps.phrase: to bow down to the ground
